Coordinates: station ways (Bhatti Chowk to Canal) or PMA-tagged OSM bus_stop nodes for the at-grade/other stations, not platform centroids.

fare_rules.concessions: Slabs = Nov-2022 structure (20/25/30/35/40, Dawn) + Rs5 raise approved Dec-2023/Feb-2024 (Pakistan Observer); Dawn (2025-11-10) confirms Rs45 current maximum. Rs50 proposal (Nov 2025) not confirmed implemented; unknown whether the March-2026 BRT hike applied. Blogs quoting Rs40 flat are outdated. Free period ended 2026-06-13.

open_questions: Orange Line current fare: Rs25-45 slabs (2024) vs unconfirmed Rs50 proposal (Nov 2025); unclear whether the March-2026 Rs40 BRT hike also changed Orange Line or Speedo fares.
Green Transport Card Rs25 Metrobus fare only from secondary news (24NewsHD/PakWheels); not seen on PMA site.
Speedo RT-01, RT-02, RT-06, RT-22, RT-26 not found on Safar or PMA; may be discontinued or converted (Electric RT20/RT26 reuse numbers).
Speedo RT-20 on Safar has conflicting title (Mull Adda - Jinnah Bus Terminal) vs stop list (Sharif Medical City - Ali Town); status unverified.
Safar lists 'Speedo LFR01 Shahdara - Gajjumata' (Rs30, 06:00-22:00 every 10 min) with the exact Metrobus station list; treated as a Metrobus data artefact, not included as a feeder route.
Orange Line station names: Wahdat Road (PMA/Safar/OSM) vs 'Saad Mughal Road' (Wikipedia); Shahnoor vs Khatam-e-Nabuwat.
Lahore Transport Company (TransLahore) routes: Wikipedia still describes ~30 routes but no 2025-26 operational confirmation found; not included.
Further announced Lahore electric routes (Shahdara - Raiwind Road, Railway Station - DHA) not confirmed launched as of 2026-09.
Overpass route-relation queries returned nothing (mirrors overloaded/area lookup empty); most feeder/electric stop coordinates are null pending geocoding.

Electric bus launch date: Dawn 2025-02-01 (formal service mid-Feb 2025); Aaj article mentions an inauguration on Wednesday 6 Aug (likely a later event). Route lengths/headways for RT20-E/RT26-E unpublished.
Speedo feeder stop lists come only from Safar (no PMA stop lists published online); RT-19..RT-28 not on PMA's Phase-I list.
